title: Frenemies: Corporate Advertising Under Common Ownership
eligible_reason: Not eligible: stacked merger-cohort design. Each financial-institution merger (1983-2011) defines a cohort of treated firms (newly commonly owned with a competitor) and control firms observed in a +/-3-year window around the announcement; observations are stacked with firm-by-merger fixed effects (Firmerid) and a relative-time Post dummy (Treat_Post Post Treat), clustered by merger. There are no calendar-time fixed effects and the panel is stacked, both excluded by PROTOCOL Section 2. Most columns also add ten lagged time-varying firm controls.
design_notes: Regression.do Table 3: reg LnAD Treat_Post Post Treat (col 1); reghdfe LnAD Treat_Post Post Treat, absorb(Firmerid) vce(cluster mergerid) (col 2, no controls); + $Control_Ln (col 3); same for ADAssets and ADSales. Tables 4-12 are subsample splits (high_50, head, High503, High500, industries), PSM sample, alternative windows, profit outcomes, continuous common-ownership share (Shares_Post), and pre-trend dummies (Treat_Pre_2, Treat_Pre_1, Table A2). Derived analysis datasets (derived/T3.DiD_sample.dta etc.) are included; raw inputs are WRDS (Thomson 13F, Compustat, CRSP) and He-Huang (2017) merger list.
n_adoption_cohorts: many merger events (stacked cohorts), but no calendar-time FE

specs.exclusion_reason: stacked design with firm-merger FE and relative-time Post; no calendar-time FE

data_provenance: real (derived WRDS-based analysis files included; raw WRDS inputs licensed)
data_files: derived/T4A.psm.dta, T4B.overlapio.dta, T4C.1year/2year.dta, T4D.change_control_firms.dta, T5.profit.dta, T6.TNIC3HHI.dta, T7-T12 .dta, TA2.parallel_trend.dta, Fig3.dta
screener_notes: If the lead wants to treat stacked designs differently, the underlying treatment (first exposure to common ownership via a mutual-fund merger) is staggered across firms, but reconstructing an unstacked firm-year panel with calendar-year FE would be a new design, not a replication of a reported specification. Screened from package only.
